title: Behrend construction of large 3-AP-free sets
difficulty_reason: The author coordinates a high-dimensional sphere layer, a digit embedding into the integers that preserves the 3-AP equation, and an optimization of dimension and base size. Pigeonholing squared norms in [m]^d gives a large sphere slice; strict convexity eliminates nontrivial 3-APs on that slice. The base 2m map preserves the arithmetic-progression equation while fitting the points into an integer interval. Choosing d about sqrt(log N) and m about exp(sqrt(log N))/2 balances the loss to exp(-C sqrt(log N)). The non-routine obligation is this linked construction and optimization; pigeonholing and strict convexity remain ordinary inputs. None of the already supplied graph regularity, removal or corners cores gives the sphere and digit construction. H2 is proposed on the actual construction, not on historical naming.
